registered_density_allocation_prediction.global_dependence: For each participant and density, mean intact correct probability minus P-off/a-on correct probability over all 28 pairs.
registered_density_allocation_prediction.interpretation_boundary: These are total causal policy dependencies in a nonlinear intact system, not additive norm fractions or unique component attributions.
registered_density_allocation_prediction.local_dependence: For each participant and density, mean intact correct probability minus a-off correct probability over all 28 pairs.
predictions: global-dependence slope upper bound below zero
local-dependence slope lower bound above zero
registered_density_allocation_prediction.replication_rule: Call the bidirectional allocation trend replicated only if both predictions pass independently in both families and all three backbones. Otherwise report partial, heterogeneous, null, or opposite directions without changing the transport outcome.
registered_density_allocation_prediction.status: secondary mechanistic prediction that cannot rescue or veto functional transport
registered_density_allocation_prediction.trend_estimator: Within each family and backbone, compute each participant's OLS slope across E in {7,8,9,10}, in probability per added observed relation, then participant-bootstrap its mean.

registered_outcome_tree.FUNCTIONAL_ASYMMETRY_NOT_SPARSITY_TRANSP: All cells are competent and interpretable, both E=8 anchors pass, but no nonbaseline density transports the complete division. Retain topology/order transport at eight edges and reject sparsity transport.
registered_outcome_tree.LIU_SPARSITY_MECHANISM_TRANSPORTED: All four edge counts transport. Promote the functional asymmetry as development-supported across the registered Liu-style sparsity range while retaining density effects and the claim boundary.
registered_outcome_tree.NONINTERPRETABLE_EXECUTION: Any integrity or E8 replay-anchor gate fails. Repair execution under a separately recorded lock without changing the registered science.
registered_outcome_tree.SPARSITY_COMPETENCE_NOT_ESTABLISHED: Any cell fails intact competence. Its mechanism result is non-interpretable; do not tune graph, model, gain, temperature, threshold, evidence magnitude, or trial count.
registered_outcome_tree.SPARSITY_DEPENDENT_OR_UNRESOLVED: At least one but not all edge counts transports, or a primary link is heterogeneous across competent backbones or graph families. Localize only the registered density, family, and link before any item-count protocol; do not add graphs or densities post hoc.
registered_outcome_tree.cell: A family-density-backbone cell passes only if all eight primary links and all source, artifact, graph, nested-schedule, nested-admission, E8-anchor, GPU-runtime, tensor-freeze, orientation, finite-value, and exactness gates pass.
registered_outcome_tree.density: An edge count transports only if both graph families pass independently in all three backbones.

registered_primary_links.P_off_a_on_direct_nontransitive: Within every cell, P-off/a-on learned correct-probability lower bound exceeds 0.50 and learned-minus-nonlearned lower bound exceeds zero.
registered_primary_links.P_off_global_collapse: Within every cell, P-off/a-on nonlearned correct-probability upper bound is at most 0.55 and P-off local remote minus 0.25 times intact global remote upper bound is below zero.
registered_primary_links.P_remote_reassembly: Within every cell, global a-off disjoint relation-LOO and third-party relational lower bounds both exceed zero.
registered_primary_links.a_off_direct_loss: Within every cell, intact minus a-off learned correct-probability lower bound exceeds zero.
registered_primary_links.constructive_global_structure: Within every cell, intact and a-off Hodge-fraction lower bounds are at least 0.95, intact transitive-triplet lower bound is at least 0.95, and intact Hodge-order tau-to-true lower bound exceeds zero.
registered_primary_links.exact_local_compression: Every finite-value and shape gate passes, and common-float64 tensor-state and all-query raw-read reconstruction maximum absolute errors are each at most 1e-12.
registered_primary_links.individualized_stable_structure: Within every cell, at least two eligible non-correct subjects exist, inter-subject tau upper bound is below 0.80, and 80-percent stable-error prevalence lower bound is at least 0.80.
registered_primary_links.intact_competence: Within every cell, participant-bootstrap lower bounds for intact learned and nonlearned exact decision accuracy both exceed 0.50.
